title: Escambia Bay Bluffs, Aerial View
description: Aerial view of the Pensacola Bay bluffs showing the coastline, railroad, and forested neighborhoods along the Bluffline corridor.

title: Bluffline Corridor Along the Bay, Aerial View
description: Aerial view of the Bluffline corridor along the bay, with railroad tracks, riprap shoreline, and lush waterfront greenery.

title: Corridor Site Visit
description: Community members explore the corridor trail toward Pensacola Bay during a 2022 site visit.

title: Walking the Corridor
description: Community members walk the Bluffline corridor along the bay, following the railroad tracks at the base of the bluffs.

title: Chimney Park from the Railroad Tracks
description: View of Chimney Park from the railroad tracks along the Bluffline corridor. Bluffline is revitalizing the park with the City of Pensacola and HALFF Associates.

title: Jackson Lakes Open House
description: Community members review an aerial map of Jackson Lakes at Bluffline's July 2024 open house at the Lexington Terrace Community Center in West Pensacola.

title: Mayor Knox White Keynote
description: Greenville, South Carolina, Mayor Knox White shares lessons from the Swamp Rabbit Trail at Bluffline's February 2025 event at the Pensacola Opera Center.

title: Greenways as Economic Catalysts Audience
description: Attendees gather at the Pensacola Opera Center to learn about trail-led economic development at Bluffline's February 2025 event featuring Mayor Knox White.

title: Gena Buchanan Reviews the Alignment Plan
description: Gena Buchanan, longtime director of the Scenic Highway Foundation, studies the Overall Bluffline Alignment Plan display at Bluffline's February 2025 event.

title: Exploring the Vision
description: Attendees discuss the Overall Bluffline Alignment Plan, a map of the future multimodal trail network, at Bluffline's February 2025 event.

title: 2025 Bluffline Defender Award
description: Gena Buchanan, longtime director of the Scenic Highway Foundation, receives the inaugural Bluffline Defender Award, an engraved walking stick, in 2025.
